# Disposition record fixtures

`current/constructed_deadline.json` is an authored ordinary current-contract
two-step deadline model. It uses hypothetical process identities and targets,
current carrier structure and unavailable artifact verification. Rust and Python
controls accept its supported disposition and reject named contradictions; it
establishes interpretation rather than live reachability.
Its embedded host bytes are authored JSON, admitted only by the controls'
explicit fixture option; current production transport uses binary records.

`response25/a1_expected.json` and its exact `a1_specimen.json` request are
unmodified historical captures from the deadline witness. Current readers refuse
their versions. `a1_known_loss.json` is preserved response-9/envelope-2 evidence
of a deadline, SIGKILL request, reaped signal and attempt-0 started progress beside
an unknown cause; it has no executable semantic consumer.

Candidate native deadline evidence is produced by
`witness_contract/worker_attempt_in_flight_at_deadline`. A retained live refresh
copies the complete envelope and exact submitted request together, preserving its
build and binary/source identities and retaining its run through the evidence
helpers. Historical captures must not be relabeled as current observations.
